findings.detail: Canadian loan rows use C$ for par amount, but cost and fair value roll into USD schedule totals; fair_value_currency should not inherit C$.
Euro swap rows show EUR only for notional amount while the fair value columns are explicitly dollar-denominated.

rationale: FX02 fired because extracted fair_value_currency is U_CAD or U_EUR. The raw schedule separates local currency markers from fair value: table 31 has C$ in the par amount currency subcolumn for Canadian loans, while cost and fair value are separate schedule value columns that sum into the USD investment total; table 35 and table 43 show euro notional amounts followed by explicit dollar-denominated fair value columns. The pipeline therefore appears to inherit the par/notional currency into fair_value_currency.
